subject.title: [Bug] OpenClaw UI WebSocket reconnect 导致会话 terminated

question: Should the remaining Control UI/WebChat active-run reconnect preservation be handled by rebasing/replacing https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/41067, by relying on a narrower recovery PR such as https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/90618, or by declaring the merged Stop/send mitigations sufficient?
rationale: Source and related-PR evidence show partial mitigations on main but no single landed contract for adopting an in-flight chat run after reconnect; choosing the permanent recovery shape and owner requires maintainer direction.

options.title: Open a current-main replacement
options.body: Use the useful active-run recovery idea from the open PRs, integrate it with the current chat lifecycle and protocol package, and require live reconnect proof before closing this issue.

options.title: Revive the open recovery PR
options.body: Ask the contributor or an adopter to rebase https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/41067, fix the review blockers, and attach real Dashboard reconnect proof.

options.title: Accept partial mitigations
options.body: Explicitly decide that Stop visibility and queued-send retry are enough, then close this issue with a narrowed explanation of what active-run adoption is not expected to cover.

recommendation.title: Open a current-main replacement
recommendation.body: Use the useful active-run recovery idea from the open PRs, integrate it with the current chat lifecycle and protocol package, and require live reconnect proof before closing this issue.

likelyOwner.reason: BunsDev authored the merged reconnect mitigations closest to this remaining Control UI/WebChat behavior.
